# Commands

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate_commands_md.py from the registered commands. Don't edit by hand: run the script. -->

Every command is a slash command; the ones marked *also `?…`* work with the `?` prefix too. `<name>` is a required parameter, `[name]` an optional one. Roles are the ones registered with `/settings`.

If the slash commands don't show up in a server, register them there with `?register` (moderators).

## WoW Guild

- **`/get_timeline_reminders`** — Fetches Bart Timeline Reminders addon info if you have a raider role.
  - **Who:** Raider, trial and moderator roles · also `?get_timeline_reminders` · answers privately
- **`/class_discords`** — Shows links to all the class Discord servers
  - **Who:** Everyone · also `?class_discords` · answers privately
- **`/submit_droptimizer <url> <profile_key>`** — Submits a Raidbots droptimizer report to the guild's WowUtils group.
  - **Who:** Raider, trial and moderator roles · also `?submit_droptimizer` · answers privately
  - `url`: Raidbots simulation report URL
  - `profile_key`: Profile key, e.g. heroic-max

*`/absence`: Absences are listed for the officers in the officer digest of each week's raid notes thread. You can also just say it in your personal officer channel ("can't make it thursday"): the bot reads it and replies with an Undo button. Officers can add or remove an absence for anyone.*

- **`/absence add <start> [end] [tentative] [note] [member]`** — Report an absence from one or more raid nights
  - **Who:** Raider, trial and moderator roles, and administrators · slash only · answers privately
  - `start`: First day: tue, tomorrow, 11/4 or 2026-11-04
  - `end` (optional): Last day, for more than one day (same format)
  - `tentative` (optional): Late, or not sure yet, rather than out
  - `note` (optional): Why, or anything officers should know (they can see it)
  - `member` (optional): Officers: the member to add it for
- **`/absence remove <id>`** — Take back an absence
  - **Who:** Raider, trial and moderator roles, and administrators · slash only · answers privately
  - `id`: The absence, from the list or /absence list
- **`/absence list [member]`** — List upcoming absences
  - **Who:** Raider, trial and moderator roles, and administrators · slash only · answers privately
  - `member` (optional): Officers: the member whose absences to list

## Utilities

- **`/source`** — Links to the bot GitHub repo
  - **Who:** Everyone · also `?source` · answers privately
- **`/help [command]`** — List the bot's commands, or show details for one of them
  - **Who:** Everyone · also `?help` · answers privately
  - `command` (optional): Command to show details for, e.g. settings
  - Give a command name to see its full description, parameters and subcommands, e.g. `/help settings` or `/help settings raid_voice`.
- **`/register`** — Register slash commands in this guild or globally
  - **Who:** Moderator role · also `?register` · not listed in `/help` · answers privately

## Debug

- **`/test_raid_notes [week]`** — Immediately create the raid notes forum thread for a given week, without waiting for the schedule.
  - **Who:** Moderator role · also `?test_raid_notes` · answers privately
  - `week` (optional): Any date (YYYY-MM-DD) in the target week; defaults to this week
  - `week` is any date (`YYYY-MM-DD`) falling in the target week; the thread is titled for that week's Tuesday–Monday span. Defaults to the current week (Eastern) when omitted.
- **`/test_raid_attendance`** — Record who is in the raid voice channel right now and post it to this week's raid notes thread.
  - **Who:** Moderator role · also `?test_raid_attendance` · answers privately
- **`/test_replay [message]`** — Post a sample delete-and-replay embed here, to preview how a reposted message looks.
  - **Who:** Moderator role · also `?test_replay` · answers privately
  - `message` (optional): Text to show in the replayed embed
  - Uses you as the stand-in author. Only exercises the embed rendering — it doesn't touch the audit log check or delete anything.

## Settings

*`/settings`: Everything here applies only to the server the command is used in. Setting the moderator role is limited to administrators.*

- **`/settings show`** — Show everything registered for this server
  - **Who:** Administrators and the moderator role · also `?settings show` · answers privately
- **`/settings mod_role <role>`** — Register the moderator (officer) role for this server. Administrators only.
  - **Who:** Server administrators only · also `?settings mod_role` · answers privately
  - `role`: Role that grants moderator commands
- **`/settings dev_role <role>`** — Register the developer role for this server. Administrators only.
  - **Who:** Server administrators only · also `?settings dev_role` · answers privately
  - `role`: Role held by the bot's developers
  - Developers run the `/ai` commands and rank above moderators for the AI features. Pick a role that only developers hold: it can't be the moderator, raider or trial role.
- **`/settings raider_role <role>`** — Register the raider role for this server
  - **Who:** Administrators and the moderator role · also `?settings raider_role` · answers privately
  - `role`: Role held by raiders
- **`/settings trial_role <role>`** — Register the trial role for this server
  - **Who:** Administrators and the moderator role · also `?settings trial_role` · answers privately
  - `role`: Role held by trial raiders
- **`/settings officer_category <category>`** — Register the category that personal officer channels are created under
  - **Who:** Administrators and the moderator role · also `?settings officer_category` · answers privately
  - `category`: Category for personal officer channels
- **`/settings officer_channel_add <user> <channel>`** — Register a personal officer channel that already exists for a member
  - **Who:** Administrators and the moderator role · also `?settings officer_channel_add` · answers privately
  - `user`: Member the channel belongs to
  - `channel`: Their existing personal officer channel
  - Once a member is registered the bot never creates a channel for them, so this is how channels made by hand (or before the bot tracked them) are made known to it.
- **`/settings officer_channel_remove <user>`** — Forget a member's personal officer channel, so the bot will create one for them again
  - **Who:** Administrators and the moderator role · also `?settings officer_channel_remove` · answers privately
  - `user`: Member to forget the channel for
- **`/settings officer_channel_list`** — List the members who have a registered personal officer channel
  - **Who:** Administrators and the moderator role · also `?settings officer_channel_list` · answers privately
- **`/settings raid_notes_channel <channel>`** — Register the forum channel that weekly raid notes threads are posted in
  - **Who:** Administrators and the moderator role · also `?settings raid_notes_channel` · answers privately
  - `channel`: Forum channel for weekly raid notes
- **`/settings raid_notes_schedule <days> <time>`** — Set when the weekly raid notes post is created (Eastern time)
  - **Who:** Administrators and the moderator role · also `?settings raid_notes_schedule` · answers privately
  - `days`: Day(s) of the week, e.g. Tue
  - `time`: Time of day, e.g. 9am or 09:00
  - Each post covers the raid week (Tuesday to Monday) it is created in; a week never gets a second one.
- **`/settings raid_nights <days> <start> <end>`** — Set the nights the guild raids and when raids start and end (Eastern time)
  - **Who:** Administrators and the moderator role · also `?settings raid_nights` · answers privately
  - `days`: Raid days, e.g. Tue, Thu
  - `start`: When each raid starts, e.g. 8pm or 20:00
  - `end`: When each raid ends, e.g. 11pm or 23:00
  - Every raid night starts and ends at the same times. An end earlier than the start means the raid runs past midnight. Raid attendance and the absences list follow these nights. Through the prefix form, wrap the days in quotes if they contain spaces.
- **`/settings raid_voice <channel>`** — Record who is in the raid voice channel at the start and end of each raid night
  - **Who:** Administrators and the moderator role · also `?settings raid_voice` · answers privately
  - `channel`: Voice channel the raid happens in
  - Recorded at the start and end of each raid night (`/settings raid_nights`), which have to be set first.
- **`/settings replay_add <user>`** — Add a member whose self-deleted messages the bot reposts
  - **Who:** Administrators and the moderator role · also `?settings replay_add` · answers privately
  - `user`: Member to replay deleted messages for
- **`/settings replay_remove <user>`** — Stop reposting a member's self-deleted messages
  - **Who:** Administrators and the moderator role · also `?settings replay_remove` · answers privately
  - `user`: Replay user to remove
- **`/settings clips_add <channel>`** — Restrict a channel to messages that contain a video
  - **Who:** Administrators and the moderator role · also `?settings clips_add` · answers privately
  - `channel`: Channel to restrict to video-only messages
- **`/settings clips_remove <channel>`** — Stop restricting a channel to video-only messages
  - **Who:** Administrators and the moderator role · also `?settings clips_remove` · answers privately
  - `channel`: Clips channel to stop restricting
- **`/settings bart_token <token>`** — Register the Bart Timeline Reminders token shown to this server's raiders
  - **Who:** Administrators and the moderator role · slash only · answers privately
  - `token`: Bart Timeline Reminders access token
  - Slash command only, so the token is never typed into a channel as a normal message.
- **`/settings wowutils <token> <group_id>`** — Register the WowUtils token and group that this server's droptimizers are submitted to
  - **Who:** Administrators and the moderator role · slash only · answers privately
  - `token`: WowUtils API token
  - `group_id`: WowUtils group ID to submit droptimizer reports to
- **`/settings wcl client <client_id> <client_secret>`** — Register the Warcraft Logs API client this server's `/wcl` commands use
  - **Who:** Administrators and the moderator role · slash only · answers privately
  - `client_id`: Warcraft Logs API client ID
  - `client_secret`: Warcraft Logs API client secret
  - Create one at warcraftlogs.com (Profile, then Manage Your Clients) and give its ID and secret.
- **`/settings wcl source <guild> <uploader>`** — Register where this server's Warcraft Logs reports are found: the guild and the uploader
  - **Who:** Administrators and the moderator role · also `?settings wcl source` · answers privately
  - `guild`: Warcraft Logs guild ID the reports are uploaded to
  - `uploader`: Warcraft Logs user ID of the account that uploads the logs
  - Both are the numeric IDs Warcraft Logs uses. Only reports from this uploader are picked when `/wcl report` is run without a link.
- **`/settings wcl mechanic_add <name> <ability_id>`** — Track an ability in the Warcraft Logs overview, to see who took damage from it
  - **Who:** Administrators and the moderator role · also `?settings wcl mechanic_add` · answers privately
  - `name`: Name to show, e.g. Coalesced Venom
  - `ability_id`: The game's ability (spell) ID
  - Give a name to show and the ability's ID as Warcraft Logs logs its damage: click the ability in a report's Damage Taken tab. It can differ from the ID on Wowhead, and one ability can be logged under more than one ID. Adding an ability that is already tracked renames it.
- **`/settings wcl mechanic_remove <name>`** — Stop tracking an ability in the Warcraft Logs overview
  - **Who:** Administrators and the moderator role · also `?settings wcl mechanic_remove` · answers privately
  - `name`: Tracked ability to remove
- **`/settings wcl mechanic_list`** — List the abilities tracked in the Warcraft Logs overview
  - **Who:** Administrators and the moderator role · also `?settings wcl mechanic_list` · answers privately
- **`/settings wcl enemy_add <name>`** — Track an enemy in /wcl damage_window, to see who damaged it and how much
  - **Who:** Administrators and the moderator role · also `?settings wcl enemy_add` · answers privately
  - `name`: The enemy's name as Warcraft Logs shows it, e.g. Sporecaller
  - Give the name exactly as Warcraft Logs shows it in a report's Damage Done tab, by target; capitals don't matter. Every enemy with that name counts as one, so a pull's adds of one kind are added together.
- **`/settings wcl enemy_remove <name>`** — Stop tracking an enemy in /wcl damage_window
  - **Who:** Administrators and the moderator role · also `?settings wcl enemy_remove` · answers privately
  - `name`: Tracked enemy to remove
- **`/settings wcl enemy_list`** — List the enemies tracked in /wcl damage_window
  - **Who:** Administrators and the moderator role · also `?settings wcl enemy_list` · answers privately
- **`/settings wcl ignore_add <name>`** — Leave a player out of the Warcraft Logs overview
  - **Who:** Administrators and the moderator role · also `?settings wcl ignore_add` · answers privately
  - `name`: Character name, e.g. Tritonian
  - An ignored player appears in no ranking, and what they took doesn't count towards any total. Give the character name; capitals don't matter. A server can ignore 50 players.
- **`/settings wcl ignore_remove <name>`** — Show a player in the Warcraft Logs overview again
  - **Who:** Administrators and the moderator role · also `?settings wcl ignore_remove` · answers privately
  - `name`: Ignored character to show again
- **`/settings wcl ignore_list`** — List the players left out of the Warcraft Logs overview
  - **Who:** Administrators and the moderator role · also `?settings wcl ignore_list` · answers privately
- **`/settings wcl consumable_add <kind> <ability_id>`** — Count an ability as a healthstone or a health potion in the Warcraft Logs consumables overview
  - **Who:** Administrators and the moderator role · also `?settings wcl consumable_add` · answers privately
  - `kind`: Healthstone or health potion
  - `ability_id`: The ability's ID as Warcraft Logs logs it
  - Give the ability's ID as Warcraft Logs logs it: click it in a report's Casts tab. A kind can have several (a plain and a demonic healthstone, two potions), and only the IDs you add are counted.
- **`/settings wcl consumable_remove <ability_id>`** — Stop counting an ability in the Warcraft Logs consumables overview
  - **Who:** Administrators and the moderator role · also `?settings wcl consumable_remove` · answers privately
  - `ability_id`: The ability's ID, as in wcl consumable_list
- **`/settings wcl consumable_list`** — List the abilities counted as healthstones and health potions
  - **Who:** Administrators and the moderator role · also `?settings wcl consumable_list` · answers privately
- **`/settings clear <setting>`** — Clear one of this server's registered settings
  - **Who:** Administrators and the moderator role · also `?settings clear` · answers privately
  - `setting`: Setting to clear

## Announcements

*`/announcement`: Slash commands only. Announcements are posted on days of the week at a time of day, Eastern time.*

- **`/announcement add <channel> <days> <time>`** — Schedule a recurring announcement; you'll be asked for the message next
  - **Who:** Moderator role · slash only · answers privately
  - `channel`: Channel to post in
  - `days`: Day(s) of the week to post on, e.g. Tue, Thu
  - `time`: Time of day to post at (Eastern), e.g. 12pm or 12:00
- **`/announcement list`** — List this server's scheduled announcements
  - **Who:** Moderator role · slash only · answers privately
- **`/announcement delete <id>`** — Delete one of this server's scheduled announcements
  - **Who:** Moderator role · slash only · answers privately
  - `id`: Announcement number, from /announcement list
- **`/announcement post <id>`** — Post one of this server's announcements right now, without waiting for its schedule
  - **Who:** Moderator role · slash only · answers privately
  - `id`: Announcement number, from /announcement list

## Warcraft Logs

*`/wcl`: Only in the threads of the raid notes forum (`/settings raid_notes_channel`), where each week has its own; the commands refuse to run anywhere else. The overview of a raid night is also posted to that week's thread by itself, shortly after the raid's scheduled end.*

- **`/wcl report [report]`** — Post the overview of a raid night's report: pulls, deaths and damage from tracked abilities
  - **Who:** Administrators and the moderator role · slash only
  - `report` (optional): Report link or code; defaults to the newest report from the registered uploader
  - Only the first two deaths in each pull are counted, since the rest is the raid wiping, and damage taken is counted up to the same moment. Only Mythic boss pulls are included. The abilities shown are the ones registered with `/settings wcl mechanic_add`. Without a report, the newest report from the uploader registered with `/settings wcl source` is used.
- **`/wcl damage_taken <ability> [boss] [report]`** — Post who took damage from one ability in a raid night's report
  - **Who:** Administrators and the moderator role · slash only
  - `ability`: A tracked ability, or a spell ID
  - `boss` (optional): Only the pulls of the boss whose name contains this
  - `report` (optional): Report link or code; defaults to the newest report from the registered uploader
  - The ability is one registered with `/settings wcl mechanic_add`, or any spell ID. Damage is counted up to the second death in each pull, since the rest is the raid wiping. Only Mythic boss pulls are included. Without a report, the newest report from the uploader registered with `/settings wcl source` is used.
- **`/wcl consumables [boss] [report]`** — Post how many healthstones and health potions were used in a raid night's report
  - **Who:** Administrators and the moderator role · slash only
  - `boss` (optional): Only the pulls of the boss whose name contains this
  - `report` (optional): Report link or code; defaults to the newest report from the registered uploader
  - Every use counts, in every pull, including once the raid had started wiping: this is about what the raid consumed. The abilities that count are the ones registered with `/settings wcl consumable_add`. Only Mythic boss pulls are included. Without a report, the newest report from the uploader registered with `/settings wcl source` is used.
- **`/wcl damage_window <boss> <start> <end> [pull] [focus] [boss_damage] [report]`** — Post how much damage each player did to each tracked enemy in a moment of a pull
  - **Who:** Administrators and the moderator role · slash only
  - `boss`: The boss whose pull it is: a name, or part of one
  - `start`: Start of the window, from the start of the pull: 40, 40s or 0:40
  - `end`: End of the window, from the start of the pull: 60, 60s or 1:00
  - `pull` (optional): Which pull of that boss, counting from 1; defaults to the last one
  - `focus` (optional): A tracked enemy to set apart; the damage to the others is added together
  - `boss_damage` (optional): Show boss against non-boss damage instead of the tracked enemies
  - `report` (optional): Report link or code; defaults to the newest report from the registered uploader
  - The times are counted from the start of the pull. Every enemy registered with `/settings wcl enemy_add` gets a ranking of the players who damaged it in that window, with the total each did; enemies with the same name count as one. With `focus`, one tracked enemy is set apart and the damage to the other tracked enemies is added together, in one ranking by the damage to the enemy set apart. With `boss_damage`, each player's damage is split instead into damage to the bosses, as Warcraft Logs counts them, and to everything else; no tracked enemies are needed. Only Mythic boss pulls are included. Without a report, the newest report from the uploader registered with `/settings wcl source` is used.
- **`/wcl replay [report]`** — Post a replay link to the last wipe in a raid night's report
  - **Who:** Administrators and the moderator role · slash only
  - `report` (optional): Report link or code; defaults to the newest report from the registered uploader
  - The last Mythic boss pull that was a wipe. The link starts 5 seconds before the first moment three players died within two seconds of each other. Without a report, the newest report from the uploader registered with `/settings wcl source` is used.

## AI

*`/ai`: Only members with the developer role (`/settings dev_role`) can use these commands, and every use is written to the bot's log with who ran it. What is switched here applies only to the server the command is used in, and is kept when the bot restarts.*

- **`/ai status`** — Show the AI features' state, model, thinking, today's use and latest failures
  - **Who:** Developer role only (`/settings dev_role`); not even administrators without it · slash only · answers privately
- **`/ai on`** — Turn the AI features on
  - **Who:** Developer role only (`/settings dev_role`); not even administrators without it · slash only · answers privately
- **`/ai off`** — Turn the AI features off for everybody
  - **Who:** Developer role only (`/settings dev_role`); not even administrators without it · slash only · answers privately
- **`/ai usage`** — Show the tokens used
  - **Who:** Developer role only (`/settings dev_role`); not even administrators without it · slash only · answers privately
- **`/ai model <name>`** — Change the model the AI features use, or go back to the configured one
  - **Who:** Developer role only (`/settings dev_role`); not even administrators without it · slash only · answers privately
  - `name`: A model name, or `default` for the one the bot was configured with
- **`/ai think <mode>`** — Turn the model's thinking on or off. On answers slower, but follows instructions better
  - **Who:** Developer role only (`/settings dev_role`); not even administrators without it · slash only · answers privately
  - `mode`: On, off, left to the model, or as configured
- **`/ai maintenance <enabled>`** — Turn maintenance mode on or off: only Officers and Developers can use the AI features
  - **Who:** Developer role only (`/settings dev_role`); not even administrators without it · slash only · answers privately
  - `enabled`: True to turn maintenance mode on, false to turn it off
- **`/ai check`** — Check the registered roles, the model server and the model
  - **Who:** Developer role only (`/settings dev_role`); not even administrators without it · slash only · answers privately
- **`/tldr`** — Sum up this channel's recent chat
  - **Who:** Raider role, moderator role, administrators and the developer role · slash only
  - Reads back up to 4 hours, stopping at the first pause of an hour or more. One per channel per hour: until then, it points to the last one. Only for raiders.

## Without a command

| Message | What happens | Who |
|---|---|---|
| A reply to someone's message with the words **"bot get them"** | Deletes the message replied to and barks. The bot needs Manage Messages in the channel | Moderator role, administrators and the developer role |
| `@bot <command>` | The same as `?<command>` | As the command |
